item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #VISPRSD
Issued at 03:07 AM 20 September 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Leyte(CityOfBaybay, Inopacan, Hindang, Hilongos, Matalom, Bato), #SouthernLeyte(Bontoc, TomasOppus and CityOfMaasin) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #VISPRSD
Issued at 02:25 AM 20 September 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Leyte(Tabango, Villaba), #Biliran(Caibiran, Cabucgayan, Biliran, Culaba), #Samar(Pinabacdao, Villareal, Talalora and Calbiga) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Biliran(Almeria, Naval), #Samar(Daram and Zumarraga) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #VISPRSD

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Watch #VISPRSD

All are advised to continue monitoring for updates.
